title: The Five-fold Cosmos; Light Through the Gates; the Three Images in the Perfect Man
description: The full integration named at every degree. T97 — the fivefold completeness of the natural cannot stand if one degree is missing; the five things the Lord makes known: the soul belongs to the kind of light, the states of light and darkness exist in such manner, the light prevails over self-love, the soul is brought out of the boundary of death by the upper gate, and the self is bound forever. T98 — how the Lord's truth comes forth through the open gates of the rational's discrete degrees: rays passing inward, taking captive light by the hand, sorting one kind upward and consigning the other to the lower side. T99 — the three forms in the righteous (spiritual, psychic, somatic), the daily soul-cycle that purifies all three, with the Virgin of Light as queen over them all and as the robe to the New Man — she who is first and last. With this the kiss without shame is fully described.
